description:
request: dialer.contacts, dialer.recents and dialer.call as the phone decodes them (each vector names its kind).
status, contacts, recents, callResult: dialer.status, dialer.contacts_result, dialer.recents_result and
dialer.call_result as the Mac decodes them; 'android': true means the phone also writes exactly that plaintext.
Expected values are normalised: requestId lowercased, absent optionals null, lengths in UTF-16 units.
Names and numbers are made up. Edit here, then run it.

request.name: contacts, request ID not a UUID

status.name: unknown contacts value reads as off

contacts.name: a contact with nothing to call is dropped
a WhatsApp entry without voice or video drops the contact
a name of 129 units is dropped
an empty number is dropped with its contact
a label of 33 units is dropped

recents.name: an unknown type reads as incoming
a type that is not a string is dropped
an address of 65 units is dropped

callResult.name: an unknown reason reads as failed
a missing reason reads as failed
a reason with started is ignored
an unknown result reads as refused
